title: Trace-Linked Variant Inspector & Rollout Diff Panel
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Build a 'Variant Inspector' view in Console that lets operators compare two model variants (canary vs baseline, A vs B, or shadow->canary mapping) with per-route metric diffs, a visual diff heatmap, and direct links into sampled traces. The panel should make it fast to (1) detect statistically significant regressions in latency, error-rate, and output-quality signals, (2) pivot from aggregate delta to example traces and request/response pairs, and (3) recommend actionable next steps (promote, hold, rollback, expand sample).
acceptance_criteria: User can select two variants and a time window and see per-route delta cards for latency (p50/p95/p99), error rate, and token generation throughput
Diff heatmap shows statistically significant buckets (by route and by token-decile) with p-values and effect size
Top 10 differential traces are surfaced with sample request, model output, and span-level timing. Clicking a trace opens full trace in APM with linked span highlighting
UI exposes a suggested rollback risk score (low/medium/high) computed from signal ensemble and allows manual rollback with a one-click action that opens the rollout workflow
Supports shadow->canary mapping: when shadow traffic exists, Variant Inspector links shadow requests to resulting canary requests for semantic diffing
End-to-end latency impact view shows both model time and infra time (queueing, kernel time) for each variant
Feature gated behind release flag 'variant-inspector' and tested on staging with synthetic traffic before canary rollout to production
tasks: PM: finalize signal set and UX flows (this ticket)
Design: high-fidelity mocks for diff panel, trace list, and rollback CTA
ENG: backend aggregation endpoints for per-route variant deltas and top-diff-trace sampler
ENG: trace-linking service to map shadow requests to executed variant traces
ENG: metrics pipeline budget review (retention/ingestion) and pre-aggregation PR
QA: E2E tests with synthetic workloads and canary rollback smoke tests
Docs: Console guide, runbook steps for interpreting Variant Inspector signals
risks_and_tradeoffs: Cardinality explosion if users compare variants across many routes and prompt-types — mitigated with pre-aggregation and limit defaults
Trace storage/ingestion cost for linking: we will use reservoir sampling and ephemeral trace links rather than full retention for every diff
Statistical false positives on short windows: show effect size and p-value, default to minimum sample size and recommend expanding the window
UI complexity: prioritize a focused first iteration (latency, error, top-diff-traces) and iterate on output-quality diffs later
rollout_plan: Feature flag behind 'variant-inspector' — enable on staging for 1 week with synthetic workloads
Beta rollout to 10% of customers (internal test orgs + willing customers) for 2 weeks
Collect usage telemetry and false-positive rate; iterate on sampling thresholds
GA with console-2025.03 if no major regressions
monitoring_and_alerting: Create monitor 'variant-inspector-api-error-rate' (SLO: 99.9% success for aggregation endpoints)
Alert policy: rollback-recommendation-changed — page on high-risk recommendations during active rollouts
Dashboard panels for API latency, aggregated sample size, and differential p-values
implementation_notes: Backend will expose /v1/rollouts/{id}/variant-diff?baseline=...&variant=...&window=... returning pre-aggregated deltas
Trace-linker will annotate traces with rollout tags (rollout_id, variant_label, shadow_id) to speed joins
Sampling: default 1% of eligible traces with adaptive increase when deltas exceed thresholds
Data retention: per-diff ephemeral cache (7 days) and aggregated metrics retained per current telemetry policy
